title: When logging in we need 2FA to validate users to protect the recipients PII so we are compliant with the Privacy act and Security Controls
body:
**What?**
- Gov.uk says their login has 2fa, does our fork have that on by default?
- Can we use SMS for 2FA even though it isn't the best option?
- Can it be disabled while we build and test?

**Why?**
- We probably need 2fa if we are going to be storing peoples names, emails, phone numbers, and other person information.
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body: @damcom333 Do we need 2FA on for this app? if so when would we have to have it turned on?

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: The app already enforces 2fa email links or sms

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body: Ok so we should just leave it be and use it for our logins to the app while it is being developed?

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: Email and SMS is probably the least secure option - would be nice to demo Yubikey, if if not that then Google 2FA

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body: On by default with Email for testing.
